release_notes: Fix: Health Connect sleep sync could get permanently stuck on a stale value for the day — a re-sync now correctly refreshes an auto-synced entry (never a manual one). Auto-synced steps/sleep are now labeled "(Auto)" so it's clear which entries came from syncing.
New exercise types: Stair Climbing and Cricket. "Gym" is retired in favor of "Weight Training" (old entries still display fine).
Fix: updating your weight now updates everywhere (Profile was stuck showing your onboarding weight even after new check-ins) — this also fixes the BMR/calorie-goal math silently using a stale weight.
Fix: the Progress weight graph now shows your trend even when your check-ins are sparser than the selected 1M/6M window, and the calorie/sleep chart tooltips no longer show raw decimal noise.
New: Home now has a day-navigator — view and edit the last 7 days, not just today (including a mini food log for past days).
New: tap any logged food item to edit it in place (quantity, meal, macros) instead of deleting and re-logging.

AI Import: two new checkboxes (both off by default) let you log a one-off result without permanently saving it as a reusable meal or adding its ingredients to "Your Ingredients". Single-ingredient imports also now prefill the actual estimated grams instead of defaulting to 100g.
New: optional weekly Cheat Day (Profile or onboarding) — pick a day and a bonus calorie amount added to that day's goal.
